maddeler.e:
نستخلف (form X)
# نَسْتَخْلِفُ (nastaḵlifu) /nas.tax.li.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَخْلَفَ (istaḵlafa)
# نَسْتَخْلِفَ (nastaḵlifa) /nas.tax.li.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَخْلَفَ (istaḵlafa)
# نَسْتَخْلِفْ (nastaḵlif) /nas.tax.lif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَخْلَفَ (istaḵlafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
